text:
elaine_cs: Quick ping — HaloTech renewal (50 seats) needs to close this week. Procurement insists on PO + vendor code but buyer says credit card okay if they cover ~2% fee. Also asked for a short security addendum. Can someone own signatures + payment path? cc @sam_csm @maria_proc

sam_csm: I can drive comms with the buyer and confirm whether they prefer CC or PO. Will check now and report back in the hour.

maria_proc: Ill take procurement. Which billing entity? If EU, need VAT details. Also need vendor code; will generate PO after SOW + billing entity confirmed.

jordan_legal: Legal fine on pricing. They requested 9mo term (pro rata) vs our 12mo. Acceptable if auto-renew remains. For addendum: ask buyer if our SOC2 report suffices or they will upload their draft.

sophia_fin: If CC chosen, we still require a PO marked "CC final" for audit. If PO/net30 and EU billing, invoice-split approval required. CC fastest for activation.

esign-bot: Draft envelope queued: HaloTech_3632100000. Waiting for SOW. Link: https://docusign.example/halo/zz123

sam_csm: Buyer prefers PO but procurement timeline could add 48-72h. On call at 3pm to confirm.

maria_proc: Vendor code VC-5500 for US, VC-EU-5500 for EU. Will prepare PO template once we get SOW + billing entity.

sam_csm: Plan: 1) 3pm call to confirm route. 2) If CC -> send DocuSign same day. 3) If PO -> submit PO and expect 2-3 business days. Aim: signature by Fri EOD. Drop blockers here.
